prerequisite: Have basic knowledge of using Microsoft Office and Internet.

general_information.Pre-Requisite: Have basic knowledge of using Microsoft Office and Internet.
general_information.Description: - The course helps students grasp the basic knowledge to build up UI screen of Web and Mobile application. Beside understanding the historical, context, requirements, the evolution, trending and challenges of graphical UI design; throughout the systematic theories and practical exercises in class will help students understand and applied the techniques and supporting tools to solve the problem of interface design websites and mobile apps. - The result of pratical exercises will be analyzed, commented, and evaluated on class by lecturer and feedback from these other students. - During the course, students are guided to collect and arrange the result step-by-step into Portfolio. - The mobile UI design will be demontrated on the Android platform.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Read the hardcopy, online book at books24x7, website w3schools and other given resources before class. - Do and complete exercises, pratices at home and on class - Access http://cms.fpt.edu.vn website to get, update learning resources, and submit as require. - Proactive on class activities: exchange idea, comments, working in group, and do the pratices,... - Complete all homework and other given missions from lecturer. - Use personal laptop for learning - Do not do private works, talks, Facebook, using mobilephone, SMS which are not relate to studying environment. - Join class at least 80% of total duration.
general_information.Tools: - Internet - Balsamiq, Moqups, LucidChart, Mindmeister, Axure - Android Studio, JDK, Genymotion

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Preliminary analysis and establish the idea.
Analyze, classify, arrange and summary information.
Overview of DataBase (DB) design for information storage
Determine user types, functionalities, Roles & Responsibilities in system.
UI prototype design for screen layouts based on software tools (Balsamiq, Axure, Moqups)
Understand the principle and how to implement UX design
Overview of programming language to create UI of Web and Mobile applications: HTML, CSS, Javascript, and XML.
Implement UI designs based on online design tools
Understand about challenges in Web & Mobile UI design
Familiar with UI prototype design tools like Balsamiq, Moqups, and database design based on LucidChart.
Collaborative working to resolve a big assignment.
Realize a design idea from begin to end to understand a full UI development life cycle

assessments.Grading Guide: Tracking of lecturer about student's activities on class (teamwork, Q&A, creating Portfolio).

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: - Project assignment help students applied knowledge and training total skill to produce a UI design project from begin to end. - Each team has 3-4 students/group - Project assignment mark has to greater or equal 4.0
assessments.Grading Guide: - It will be conducted on A0 paper size - After evaluation, students capture and digitalize their result, printout and keep it in Portfolio, A4 paper size. - These best designs will be collected and submit to Group Leader as references for these next classes or used to hang in the classroom, exhibition.
assessments.Note: The product will be evaluated based on five factors included: - Good analysis and design 3 points - Layout and schematic 2 points - Coloring 1 point - Ease of use, convenience 2 points - Creative, innovations, and stylish 2 points
